hero_prepress_author_20261031.directive: Clear the three hero rubric defects with deterministic framing/shadow/background guardrails; transfer the plate's own luminance onto bottle/tube labels; author prompts dynamically on the local 27B (:8080); enforce 300 DPI and emit a measured-quad .dieline.json sidecar.
hero_prepress_author_20261031.hero_remediation: listing_image.py: subject scaled to 0.82 fill, 10% target margins with a 5% auto-rescale trigger, contact shadow clipped to the subject footprint (plus 2% of canvas below for a visible ramp), every non-subject/non-shadow pixel forced to exact 255. audit_white now reports background_purity on the outer 6% ring, subject bbox and margins. asset_rubric.score_listing uses background purity for background_not_white_enough/contact_shadow_or_floor; the old whole-image statistic made 0.90 purity mathematically impossible at 85% fill. Live heroes: 90.1-95.1, defects [], background purity 1.0, margins ~9% side / ~7% bottom.
hero_prepress_author_20261031.curvature_shading: format_compositors._apply_luminance extracts the plate's grayscale L(x,y), normalizes by the label-area median, and multiplies the label by 1 + strength*(L/median - 1), clamped. Bottle applies it to the resampled crop; tube to the warped label before masking. Default strength 0.35. Tests pin left-dark/right-bright transfer and shading-off identity; live bottle/tube heroes show the vessel highlight and falloff continuing through the print.
hero_prepress_author_20261031.local_27b_author: NEW prompt_author.py: OpenAI-compatible POST to 127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (alias northstaros-27b-coder). Brief carries format + verbal form note, geometry profile, product/substrate/tier, brand_memory facts, memory_bank.retrieve_context, lighting/camera/background and the unprinted-plate bans. Fail-closed on unreachable/empty/truncated completion -> PromptAuthorUnavailable; runner records author_unavailable and does not render a template. Runner authors all four, stops the lane, waits for VRAM, then renders. 5 s settle + one warm-up completion fixes the /health-before-slot reset.
